Health Functional FoodNiacin 11mgVitamin B1 0.9mgVitamin B2 1.1mgVitamin B6 1.1mgZinc 8mgOnce a day

키즈쑥쑥 젤리Niacin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Zinc

Made by 농업회사법인(주)힐링팜 · Once a day · 1 sachet

This product combines 11mg of Niacin, 0.9mg of Vitamin B1, 1.1mg of Vitamin B2, 1.1mg of Vitamin B6, 8mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 sachet): 11mg Niacin, 0.9mg Vitamin B1, 1.1mg Vitamin B2, 1.1mg Vitamin B6, 8mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 농업회사법인(주)힐링팜

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 sachet per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (11mg / 20g), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (0.9mg / 20g), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.1mg / 20g), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.1mg / 20g), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8mg / 20g), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 연한 노란색의 젤리
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 18개월
Storage -고온다습한 곳과 직사광선을 피하여 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Zinc together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
